issue.title: Data race in ControllerManager::update() (controller_manager.cpp:2186)
issue.body:
## Summary                                                                                                                                             
  ThreadSanitizer reports a data race in `controller_manager::ControllerManager::update()` during concurrent control-cycle execution.                    
                                                                                                                                                         
  ## Affected Location                                                                                                                                   
  - `controller_manager/src/controller_manager.cpp:2186`                                                                                                 
  - Function: `ControllerManager::update(rclcpp::Time const&, rclcpp::Duration const&)`                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                         
  ## Observed Result                                                                                                                                     
  ThreadSanitizer reports concurrent writes in `ControllerManager::update()`.                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                         
  ```text                                                                                                                                                
  WARNING: ThreadSanitizer: data race (pid=413)                                                                                                          
    Write of size 4 ...                                                                                                                                  
      #0 controller_manager::ControllerManager::update(...) .../controller_manager.cpp:2186                                                              
    Previous write of size 4 ...                                                                                                                         
      #0 controller_manager::ControllerManager::update(...) .../controller_manager.cpp:2186                                                              
  SUMMARY: ThreadSanitizer: data race .../controller_manager.cpp:2186 in controller_manager::ControllerManager::update(...)
